_comment: The API's eligibility reasons per strategy (planning/selector.py) and its finding messages (planning/preflight.py) for each finding case - `others` are the plan's other selected VMs, `source_kind` the source provider's kind (openstack when not given): test_selector.py and test_preflight.py run them against the API, mockData.test.ts against the dashboard's mock, which words them as the API does (SDD §9.2, §9.3, §16, review RV20-08). source/destination give a provider's capabilities and whether it has a conversion host, as provider_caps reads them.

cases.why: an OpenStack VM every strategy takes

an OpenStack VM in error, without conversion hosts or admin rights, a source compute below 2.85, ports Nova cannot recreate, a multi-attach, an image-backed, an encrypted and an unmapped disk, handover off, and a blocker

cold: source VM is in error state
no conversion host configured on the source provider
no conversion host configured on OpenStack 2026.2 Hibiscus (DC3)
port(s) without exactly one fixed IP, which Nova cannot recreate: app-net (no fixed IP), db-net (10.0.0.5, fd00::5)
warm: source VM is in error state
no conversion host configured on the source provider
no conversion host configured on OpenStack 2026.2 Hibiscus (DC3)
port(s) without exactly one fixed IP, which Nova cannot recreate: app-net (no fixed IP), db-net (10.0.0.5, fd00::5)
storage_handover: storage handover is not enabled for this plan
disk(s) not backed by Cinder volumes: root
volume type(s) without a backend of OpenStack 2026.2 Hibiscus (DC3) in handover.backend_map: <default>, ceph-hdd
port(s) with several fixed IPs, of which one would be kept: db-net (10.0.0.5, fd00::5)
encrypted disk(s), which Cinder cannot unmanage: vol-3
admin rights are required on the source cloud
admin rights are required on OpenStack 2026.2 Hibiscus (DC3)
the source's compute API 2.79 is below 2.85 (the handover's delete_on_termination update of the source server)

cases.why: a transitioning OpenStack VM through Neutron (every address kept), a pool the destination does not list

cold: source VM is in transitioning state
warm: source VM is in transitioning state
storage_handover: vol-1: OpenStack 2026.2 Hibiscus (DC3) lists no pool hostgroup@ceph#gold (RBD pools of hostgroup@ceph: hostgroup@ceph#silver)

cases.why: an unmapped volume type named like an Object.prototype key, on a listed pool, with destination pools (review RV21-11)

storage_handover: volume type(s) without a backend of OpenStack 2026.2 Hibiscus (DC3) in handover.backend_map: constructor

cases.why: a port with several fixed IPs through Nova, one an override gives

cold: port(s) without exactly one fixed IP, which Nova cannot recreate: app-net (10.0.0.7, 10.0.0.8)
warm: port(s) without exactly one fixed IP, which Nova cannot recreate: app-net (10.0.0.7, 10.0.0.8)
storage_handover: port(s) with several fixed IPs, of which one would be kept: app-net (10.0.0.7, 10.0.0.8)

cases.why: a VMware VM in error without CBT, with an independent disk, and a blocker

vmware_cold: source VM is in error state
vmware_warm: Changed Block Tracking (CBT) is not enabled

cases.why: a transitioning VMware VM with CBT on

vmware_cold: source VM is in transitioning state

finding_cases.why: an encrypted volume, and volume types handover cannot map (a typed and an untyped volume; an ephemeral disk is no volume)

expected.HANDOVER_BACKEND_UNMAPPED: Volume type(s) without a handover backend: <default>, ceph-hdd.

finding_cases.why: a VM other selected VMs share its name with: the name quoted, the others by project and id - '-' for none - sorted

expected.SRC_VM_DUPLICATE_NAME: Another selected VM is also named 'web-01' (-/vm-2, hr/vm-3); os-migrate selects workloads by name.

expected.SRC_VM_ERROR_STATE: Source VM err-01 is in error state.

finding_cases.why: a VM with a Nova task in flight

expected.SRC_VM_TRANSITIONAL_STATE: Source VM busy-01 has a Nova task in flight (resize, migration, rescue, rebuild or reboot); a stop or snapshot would fail.

expected.SRC_VM_EPHEMERAL_ROOT: The root disk is image root.

a flavor asking PCI passthrough and a vGPU

the VMware checks read the VM's own fields, whatever the source's kind

expected.GUEST_OS_UNKNOWN: The guest OS is not identified (Plan 9).

expected.APP_PROBE_MISSING: db-02 is a database VM without an application probe: verification would check only that it booted.
